title: Ankhorage Surface
summary: Provides the stable React Native and React Native Web UI foundation used to compose Ankhorage interfaces.
purpose: Offer reusable, theme-aware UI primitives and higher-level controls behind a consistent cross-platform public API.
responsibilities: Publish reusable layout, typography, feedback, form, navigation, overlay, image, icon, and surface components.
Define theme, semantic color, responsive layout, and interaction-policy primitives for React Native and React Native Web.
Provide explicit platform adapters where browser or native behavior differs.
boundaries: Does not own application manifests, business workflows, data fetching, or runtime capability execution.
Does not provide product-specific screens or application navigation policy.
Does not select host-level providers, deployment targets, or external service integrations.
audience: React Native and React Native Web application authors composing Ankhorage interfaces.
Package maintainers building controls and visual foundations on stable Surface primitives.
useCases: Compose a responsive screen from themed layout, typography, form, and feedback components.
Provide a semantic theme to controls rendered on native and web hosts.
Use browser and native overlay, popover, toast, and interaction primitives through one public package API.

architecture.role: Reusable UI and design-system library with explicit React Native and React Native Web platform boundaries.
invariants: Components expose stable public props and derive visual behavior from shared semantic theme primitives.
Application workflow, data access, and capability execution remain outside the UI foundation.
Platform-specific behavior remains behind explicit adapters while public component contracts stay cross-platform.

limitations: Consumers must supply the declared React, React Native, and platform peer dependencies required by the components they use.
Optional icon and native interaction capabilities depend on the corresponding declared peer packages and host configuration.
